type.note: Dealer sales are taxed under the Retailers' Occupation Tax and reported on Form ST-556.

stateRateNew.note: 6.25% state rate on general merchandise, which includes items titled or registered by the state.

localAllowed.note: Dealers apply the rate printed on their return for their location; Chicago adds a 1.25% Home Rule Use Tax.

rule.note: The qualified trade-in value is subtracted from the selling price (ST-556 Section 6, Lines 2-3).

cap.note: The $10,000 trade-in limit applied only to sales from 2020-01-01 to 2021-12-31.

rebateTreatment.note: "Do not subtract the value of any rebate made directly to the customer."

taxable.note: Documentary fees are listed among the costs included in the taxable selling price (ST-556 Line 1).

accessories.note: Accessories are listed in the taxable selling price (ST-556 Line 1).

notes.text: Vehicles bought from a Chicago dealer also owe the 1.25% Chicago Home Rule Use Tax. Include it in the combined rate.
The documentary fee cap was $300 from January 1, 2020, adjusted each year by the Consumer Price Index. The current-year cap is not yet sourced.
